# Create Panorama folder rows on demand and preserve the current numeric-ID contract

Entry 2116 inserts a root row when the server lookup has no root, changes a missing folder row from generic failure to NS_MSG_ERROR_FOLDER_SUMMARY_MISSING, and implements CreateNewDB by inserting a child row then opening its per-folder database. These replace eager startup folder population removed in entry 2115. The fixed root path still inserts missing roots, using numeric IDs, and current CreateNewDB inserts a child only if GetFolderChildNamed returns 0. Current OpenFolderDB is keyed by the folder ID and uses a weak per-folder cache; the old object lookup and missing-summary branch are historical. Preserve missing/existing distinctions and caller output ownership when changing this path. No missing root, child creation, repeat call, insertion failure, cache lifetime or runtime test ran. Full discussion is pending.

Scope: Panorama folder row creation.
